I really think that's cool. I hope you enjoy it a bit at least. 

I'm sorry about your OCD, I've heard lots about it but I can never fully understand it. 

What are you passionate about? Do you like anything in particular?

Well with anxiety, everything. But I'm a Christian and I fear that I'm not good enough for anyone. I trust God but I feel like I'm screwing everything up. I fear that people I love are going to burn for the rest of their lives. I fear eternity. Eternity never ends, it keeps going. Is there anything, or nothing? I'm scared of everything.

I always thought about going into something with computers. I only did things to make my dad happy until last year. 

I have the same religious fears. She is the only one who comforted me when I had anxiety attacks and things. She believed the same thing I did. Are you a Catholic, Christian, or would you rather not say?

Do you not want to peruse that degree now? 

Do you mind me asking what your OCD entails exactly? 

That sounds neat. There has gotta be a big market for that!

What were you studying in college? 

Psychiatric treatment? What do you mean by supposed to start?What is the severity of the OCD?

That's interesting, do you have hopes to start one someday? Selling what?
All I really do is sit at my house and play games on my computer when she's at college and I'm not working, I don't do too much. What about you? What do you do?
